findings.comment: Exterior lighting note does not specify that requirements apply only to new or proposed lighting. Note states 'All exterior lighting will be full cut-off and fully shielded' without limiting scope to new/proposed fixtures, which could be interpreted to require modification of existing lighting. Revise note to specify 'new or proposed exterior lighting.'

codeCitations: General Site Plan Notes for COA
findings.comment: Exterior lighting note does not specify application within limits of construction or project-specific boundaries. Note applies 'All exterior lighting' site-wide without scope limitation. Revise note to specify application 'within the limits of construction' or 'within project-specific boundaries.'

applicableAreas: landscape plan and civil site plan base
findings.comment: Landscape plan building footprints, layout, and building placement cannot be verified to match civil site plan. Vision analysis of Sheet 31 landscape plan suggests spatial arrangement of buildings may differ from Sheet 9 civil plan configuration. Coordinate with landscape architect to confirm building footprints and site layout are identical between plans.

Zoning Case No. C14-2011-0093 is referenced on cover sheet, but the specific conditions of approval from this zoning case are not identified or demonstrated on the site plan. Conditions of approval, if any exist for this case, must be obtained from zoning case records and verified for compliance on the plan.
